providers.market_view: The US equity market is navigating a period of heightened volatility characterized by a rotation away from high-momentum technology and AI-infrastructure leaders into defensive sectors like healthcare and consumer staples. While broader indices have faced pressure following the midterm elections and concerns over AI spending sustainability, selective opportunities are emerging in industrial and technology stocks that have demonstrated robust fundamental strength and positive forward guidance. The backdrop remains cautious as investors weigh valuation compression in growth sectors against historically elevated valuations in defensive proxies.

results.summary:
## What happened?

Shares of heating and cooling solutions company AAON (NASDAQ: AAON) jumped 23.8% in the morning session after the company delivered record third-quarter 2026 financial results and raised its full-year sales growth outlook.

According to a company press release, AAON reported that third-quarter net sales climbed 84.1% year-over-year to $707.4 million. Operating income jumped 129.3% to $100.0 million, while GAAP diluted earnings per share leaped 124.3% to $0.83. Management also lifted the full-year 2026 sales growth guidance to a range between 72% and 75%. results.summary:
AAON Inc. (NASDAQ:AAON) stock surged Tuesday after the HVAC equipment maker beat third-quarter 2026 earnings and revenue estimates and raised its full-year sales forecast above Wall Street expectations.

After the results, Baird analyst Timothy Wojs maintained an Outperform rating but cut his price forecast to $104 from $110.

## AAON Earnings Beat Estimates As Margins Improve

AAON reported adjusted earnings of 83 cents per share, beating the 57-cent estimate.

Revenue jumped 84.1% year over year to a record $707.4 million, topping the $599.7 million estimate.

GAAP earnings rose to 83 cents per share from 37 cents a year earlier.

Gross margin narrowed to 26.7% from 27.8% a year earlier but improved 60 basis points from the previous quarter.

selected.main_risk: Supply chain disruptions affecting component availability for large-scale custom units.
selected.thesis: The company reported record third-quarter results and raised its full-year sales guidance, benefiting from structural demand for high-performance HVAC systems in data centers and commercial buildings. This trend is less sensitive to the 'AI software' bubble concerns and more tied to physical infrastructure needs.
selected.why_move_is_not_spent: Despite the initial price reaction, the company's backlog and capacity expansion plans provide visibility into sustained growth through 2027. The shift toward higher-margin custom solutions serves as a continuing tailwind for margin expansion in the coming days.

providers.market_view: US equities entered a correction phase in early November 2026 following a tech-heavy rally collapse that erased trillions in market value. Technical indicators show RSI divergence and fading momentum, with sector rotation masking underlying fragility. The backdrop features elevated macro risk including multiple Fed speaker appearances, US CPI data release, and geopolitical developments. Most post-earnings momentum candidates have already realized their initial gap-up moves, leaving limited actionable setups with favorable risk-reward for 1-5 session horizons.

Backdrop into the cutoff was stabilization after a weak tech-led session tied to hot inflation and AI capex concerns. With the bond market closed for the holiday, equity futures suggested a steadier reopen and beaten AI hardware attempting to firm. Action was stock-specific around earnings updates, licensing talk and government awards rather than broad chase.
